g.text: Services: one package each, never importing another; cross-service effects go through the jobs catalogue

text.tspan: Postgres: the operations table is the job queue
jobs.Enqueue* writes a row in the cause's transaction;
the runner claims each kind for the service that runs it

g.text: runs: its job handlers; queues: kinds it enqueues for others
the 60 s tick on every worker
